title: Step 6 - Add Animations to User Clicks
section: 20. Boss Level Challenge 2 - The Simon Game
summary: Add a pressed visual effect for 100 ms on clicked buttons.

concepts.heading: animatePress(currentColour)
points: Takes the colour name and selects $("#" + currentColour).
The .pressed class in styles.css adds a white box-shadow and grey background.
addClass("pressed") applies it; setTimeout with 100 ms later calls removeClass("pressed").
Call animatePress(userChosenColour) from the click handler.

concepts.heading: Delay
points: setTimeout(fn, ms) runs fn once after the delay; search 'how to add delay javascript' finds it.

task.expected_result: Buttons flash grey with glow on click.
